base_ms_per_token.label: measured
base_ms_per_token.source: packet58as v5 B0/B1 and packet171b A views

measured_law.statement: On the spin line the slow token/error readback occurs only on the token whose position-start boundary submitted fills; its excess is linear in that token's fill bytes with ~zero intercept, i.e. the whole fill drains at ~28.6 GB/s after compute and before the readback completes.

candidates.name: fill pacing (bounded chunks over N tokens / bytes-in-flight cap)
candidates.labels: measured-derived (linear law, zero absorption: total bytes unchanged) + assumed admission delay cost

candidates.name: fill timing (submit after the tail readbacks / after the last zero-copy expert)
candidates.labels: assumed host-gap absorption 0.2-0.4 ms per fill token; measured zero absorption even in the existing CCS-idle put/prepare window argues for ~0

candidates.name: second-touch admission, W=256 positions, fixed before the replay
candidates.labels: transferred replay (packet55 two-card target routes, parent overlap cadence, 21.55 GB LRU): fills -43%, misses +21%; scaled x2.12 to the measured one-card fill rate: -13.2 MB/token x 0.041 ms/MB (measured) = -0.54 ms; +6.9 misses/token x 0.077 ms/miss (transferred from packet58x capacity result 1.55 ms/token for -13.5 misses and -12.4 MB fills) = +0.53 ms
candidates.insight: A serialized 2 MB fill costs about what the zero-copy miss it prevents costs; admission tuning cannot win while fills are serialized.

candidates.name: fill kick: one non-blocking zeCommandListHostSynchronize(maintenance list, 0) after each fill batch
candidates.labels: measured ceiling (readback excess); assumed mechanism (fills held until a host synchronization; supported by zero absorption even while the CCS is idle); assumed 0-0.5 ms/token compute contention once a ~61 MB fill overlaps compute
candidates.exactness: same plans, fills, evictions and publication boundaries; tables per position identical by construction

candidates.name: kernel-store tail readback (CCS writes token/error and route logs into pinned host memory; no copy engine on the token tail)
candidates.labels: measured ceiling; assumed transfer of the fill remainder to the next copy-engine user; packet171b DO-NOT-REPEAT family (171b's compute-queue memcpy likely stayed copy-engine work under UR v2 copy offload, assumed)
